parameters.name: AgentId
parameters.description: The ID of the agent that executes the task.

parameters.name: DeleteAfterRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically delete the job after its first execution. This is useful for one-time tasks. Default: `false`.

parameters.name: Delivery
parameters.description: The configuration for delivering task execution results.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether the cron job is enabled. Default: `true`.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The unique name of the task.

parameters.name: Restart
parameters.description: Specifies whether to restart the gateway upon job creation. Default: `true`.

parameters.name: RunImmediately
parameters.description: Specifies whether to run the job once immediately upon creation. Default: `false`.

parameters.name: SessionKey
parameters.description: The session routing key, which determines the conversation session for the task.

parameters.name: SessionTarget
parameters.description: The session target. Valid values are `main`, `isolated`, and `current`.

parameters.name: WakeMode
parameters.description: The wake mode for the agent. Valid values are `now` and `next-heartbeat`.
